newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar steady, trade awaits free sale quota.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar steady, trade awaits free sale quota.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Tuesday were steady as the trade awaited a government announcement on the free sale quota, dealers said.
They said traders kept away in anticipation of a quota announcement. The quota for June is 800,000 tonnes while a quota of about 750,000 tonnes is expected for July, dealers said.
Consumer demand was slow but limited arrivals and scattered offerings by the local stockist kept prices quiet.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was steady at 1,450/1,475 rupees per quintal so was M-30 at 1,475/1,510 rupees per quintal. Sugar mill delivery was steady at 1,390/1,410 rupees per quintal for the S-30 variety and at 1,415/1,435 rupees for the M-30 variety.
